quote: And suddenly, all the love songs were about you.

opener.hint: Two lives, one thread — pull them together

groom.title: A loud arrival
groom.text: Liam arrived two weeks early, mid-thunderstorm, already impatient for the good part.

cameo.caption: That warm glimmer low on the horizon? A girl arrives with the dawn, one year from now.

groom.title: Paper pilot
groom.text: Champion of paper planes off the school roof. Grounded twice. Worth it, he says.

cameo.caption: The small figure on the far hill, jar in hand, collecting proof of a good day — that's her.

groom.title: The quiet years
groom.text: Books, late buses, a notebook of half-finished songs nobody was allowed to read.

cameo.caption: That doodle isn't his ink. It blew in from a notebook three streets away.

groom.title: City windows
groom.text: First job, sixth floor. He counted lit windows at night and wondered who was behind them.

cameo.caption: One window across the street never went dark before midnight. Hers.

groom.title: Looking
groom.text: He didn't know what he was looking for. He just kept a seat free, everywhere he went.

cameo.caption: She passed this exact lamp post four minutes before him. The city kept practicing.

bride.title: Born under a kind moon
bride.text: Sora arrived at dawn, unbothered, as if she already knew how this story ends.

cameo.caption: The storm leaving on the horizon? It announced a boy, one year before her.

bride.title: Collector of small things
bride.text: Pressed flowers, bus tickets, bottle caps — anything that proved a good day happened.

cameo.caption: The paper plane crossing her sky flew three rooftops to get there. Guess whose.

bride.title: The margin artist
bride.text: Every notebook she owned: half lessons, half doodles. The doodles aged better.

cameo.caption: One note in the margin isn't hers — a half-finished song that drifted in.

bride.title: Lights on late
bride.text: Design school, then a studio job. Hers was the window still lit at midnight.

cameo.caption: Across the street, someone counted lit windows every night. He always ended on hers.

bride.title: Almost
bride.text: Three near-misses: same train, same café, same rainy bookshop. The city kept practicing.

cameo.caption: Same train, same café, same rainy bookshop. He was the blur in all three.

meeting.title: The borrowed pen
meeting.text: A lecture hall neither of them wanted to be in. One pen between them. The city finally got it right.

proposal.title: The question
proposal.text: Seven years after the borrowed pen, on a hill above the city that kept missing its cue — he asked. She said the easiest yes of her life.

moments.caption: First trip, wrong train, right person
The yes, about four seconds after

wishes.name: Anna & Theo
wishes.message: Finally! We've been waiting for this since the bookshop story. See you in September!

wishes.name: Dan
wishes.message: The paper plane champion got the best landing of all. Proud of you, brother.

wishes.name: Aunt Margot
wishes.message: May your home be loud with laughter and your table always full.

wishes.name: Kev
wishes.message: Stuck overseas but cheering loudly from here. Save me a slice of everything.

wishes.name: Studio Eight
wishes.message: To our midnight-window girl — may every light ahead be warm. Congratulations!

wishes.name: Mr. Harlan
wishes.message: Two kind people, one kind life. Blessings to you both.

closing: With love, we can't wait to celebrate with you.
